sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Starting the app in the browser
sections.what: Loads the global styles, applies the saved theme, and draws the main App inside the page's root element.
sections.why: Likely reason: the theme is applied first so no wrong colors flash before the app appears.
sections.watch_out: The root element must exist. If it is missing, startup fails and the page stays blank.

summary: Starts the web app: sets the theme, then draws the main App inside the page.
purpose: The first code that runs in the browser for this app.
why: The theme file's comment says the theme is set before the first render so the wrong theme never flashes. This file follows that order.
how: 1. Loads the global styles. 2. Sets the theme. 3. Finds the page element named root. 4. Draws the App component inside it.
inputs: The page's root element, the saved theme, and the App component.
risks: If the root element is missing, startup fails. No error boundary wraps the whole app here, so a crash during startup shows a blank page.
debug: If the page is blank, open the browser console and check that the root element exists in the HTML page. If the theme flashes, check that the theme is set before the draw call.
